title: 22-Layer Dual-Cavity Filter with Physics-Constrained Thickness Initialization
scientific_hypothesis: Clamping spacer and cavity layer thicknesses to [50, 150] nm during initialization will seed the optimizer onto the primary resonance manifold, reducing convergence time and improving final target score compared to unbounded initialization, while preserving the 22-layer dual-cavity topology that achieved 0.955 target score in iteration_01.
design_principle: Quarter-wave optical thickness initialization around target center wavelengths (3.3 μm and 4.25 μm) for cavity/spacer layers, with gradient-based thickness optimization over all 22 layers under the same physical bounds as route_01.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | CaF2 substrate (22 finite layers)
design_variables: All 22 layer thicknesses with gradient optimization
Initialization clamped to [50, 150] nm for cavity/spacer layers
soft_objectives: Maximize transmittance in 3.25-3.35 μm and 4.20-4.30 μm bands
Minimize transmittance in 2.50-3.10 μm and 4.45-5.00 μm bands
Improve target score beyond 0.955 achieved in route_01
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness control at nanometer scale required
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack principle for bandpass filters
Transfer matrix method for multilayer optimization
Physics-constrained initialization reduces search space to resonance manifold
expected_advantages: Faster convergence due to informed initialization
Higher final target score from better starting point
known_risks: Initialization window may be too restrictive for some cavity orders
May converge to local optimum within constrained manifold
execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer planar multilayer filter on CaF2 substrate with Air incidence. Stack sequence: Air | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | CaF2. All 22 layer thicknesses are optimization variables. Apply physics-constrained initialization: clamp all cavity and spacer layer thicknesses to [50, 150] nm range before gradient optimization begins. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with uniform physical bounds. Score candidates on transmittance: high in 3250-3350 nm and 4200-4300 nm bands, low in 2500-3100 nm and 4450-5000 nm bands. Normal incidence, unpolarized illumination. No metal layers permitted. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 2500-3100 nm, 3250-3350 nm, 4200-4300 nm, 4450-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands; Low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 24; No metal layers; Conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: physics-constrained initialization clamping spacer/cavity layers to [50, 150] nm to seed population onto primary resonance manifold, while preserving the verified 22-layer dual-cavity topology from route_01.
